title: Founder with a complete product brief
openingPrompt:
Patients book visits; clinic staff manage schedules; providers see their clinics only.

- Role-based booking and clinic tenancy
- No insurance billing, video visits, or prescriptions in v1
- Success: staff can book inside their clinic without seeing other clinics

Already accepted: starter stack, Neon Postgres, email reminders only, clinic-scoped records.

Open: cancellation window, waitlist, who sets provider hours.
